title: Drunk Shakespeare Ticket: Phoenix, AZ
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Get ready for a hilarious take on Shakespeare during this unique, 90-minute show in downtown Phoenix. Located in a hidden library speakeasy at The Rose Theatre, this quirky performance showcases an intoxicated cast member. One classically-trained actor has at least five shots of whiskey and then attempts to perform in a Shakespearean play. The results are what Slate magazine describes as ‘the best thing to ever happen to the theater.’ Craft cocktails are available for purchase during the show and there is a special treat upon arrival. 21+ ONLY
